Michael / Laura —

Thanks for the feedback and Laura for the timing note. We're prepared to accept the following compromise:

- Notice: Redwood will notify Acme "promptly" and in any event within 10 business days of receipt of a third-party IP claim.
- Election: Redwood may assume defense only if it notifies within that 10-day window. If Acme elects to assume defense, Acme must notify Redwood within 14 days of Redwood's notice.
- Settlement: Redwood will not settle in a manner that negatively affects Acme without Acme's written consent; Redwood will not admit fault where Acme contests liability.
- Insurance: Redwood will maintain Commercial General Liability and Technology E&O with minimum limits of $5M each; certificate to be provided prior to signature.
- Cooperation: Redwood will preserve evidence and provide a single point of contact for discovery-related requests.
